messages:
elaine: Heads-up — multiple reports of lost admin perms after last night's RBAC refactor/deploy. Looks correlated to users who sign in via Okta.
devin: saw the alert. Any commonalities? group->role mapping change landed in the mapping service yesterday.
elaine: common pattern: affected accounts have a secondary role claim in the SAML assertion. Okta used to send single `roles` string, now it's an array. JIT mapping seems to pick the first element, which in the new ordering is the low-priv role.
samir: can you paste an example assertion? this will help see mapping code path.
elaine: here's a redacted example from debug logs (okta-bot gave it):
```
<saml:Attribute Name="roles">
  <saml:AttributeValue>viewer</saml:AttributeValue>
  <saml:AttributeValue>admin</saml:AttributeValue>
</saml:Attribute>
```
elaine: old behavior: we normalized and favored `admin` if present. new refactor changed precedence to pick index 0.
devin: oh, that was my change to de-dupe and keep deterministic order. I didn't realize Okta might reorder claims for some orgs.
elainе: (typo) elaine: @devin can we hotfix mapping to detect presence of any elevated role rather than index-based pick?
devin: yes, I can drop a patch to iterate values and prefer roles by our priority list.
oncall-sre: oncall-sre: we have ~23 incidents tied to this during the 01:00-02:30 UTC window. Customers impacted: internal admin console and a few support tools.
samir: we need to confirm if JIT created additional user objects with minimal grants. If so, that's an audit gap — the original assertion content isn't preserved anywhere.
elaine: correct. current audit log entry only records final assigned role and user id, not the raw assertion (we didn't persist to avoid PII).
devin: question: do we want to persist SAML role claims in audit logs? could be useful for triage but may contain email/ids.
elaine: suggestion: persist only role names (no PII) and encrypt with KMS. That lets us replay mappings during postmortem and prevents plaintext storage.
samir: agree. We need KMS envelope + rotate policy. Also need to add a flag to redact attributes not whitelisted.
elainе: elaine: (fixing earlier name) I'll open a remediation RFC. Key items: 1) quick patch to mapping (prefer highest-privilege in array) 2) backfill audit logs for impacted sessions by reprocessing stored SAML (if available) 3) KMS encrypt role-claim snapshots going forward 4) add unit + integration tests for array claims and precedence.
devin: patch ready, running unit tests now. will push canary in 5.
oncall-sre: oncall-sre: please coordinate canary rollout to avoid thrashing. throttle to 5% for 15m.
samir: for backfill: we have ephemeral debug dumps from okta-bot for ~60% of affected flows. I'll write a small reprocessor to emit encrypted audit rows.
elaine: one more ask: product/security want an incident blurb for customers and a mitigation timeline.
devin: can we include a snippet of the mapping fix? quick diff:
```
- assigned = values[0]
+ for v in values:
+   if v in HIGH_PRIORITY_ROLES:
+     assigned = v
+     break
+ else:
+   assigned = values[0]
```
elaine: perfect. I'll draft the customer note and post to #announcements once legal signs off.
okta-bot: okta-bot: debug dump available: /secure/logs/saml/1832100000/okta-debug-ella.json (redacted)
elaine: thanks. action items summarized in the RFC thread I'm creating. tagging @devin @samir @oncall-sre. we'll follow up with postmortem and next steps for KMS integration/encryption policy.
devin: pushed canary at 1832100035, observing.
samir: reprocessor started at 1832100060, writing encrypted audit rows to the secure-audit table.
oncall-sre: incident status: mitigated -> partial mitigation in place. monitoring 30m.
elaine: closing this Slack thread; continuing coordination in the incident RFC. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
